### White Shrimp  

Using seasonal data for white shrimp, to separate non-spawning adults (time period 2 for a calendar year, season Fall, Months Aug-Dec) from spawners (time period 1 of the next calendar year, season Winter-Spring-Summer, months Jan-July).   

The input file contained heads-off landings from SC and GA.

## Trip Ticket Data  

For browns, compile to annual totals.  

For whites, ideally compile to the same seasons reported in landings: Jan-Jul and Aug-Dec. However the waves here split; Jul-Aug are combined. Based on the nursery period dates for this species starting in June, I'll ..... cut it off at June?



::: {.cell}
::: {.cell-output-display}
![White Shrimp Landings in GA and SC, by wave. These landings are reported as head-off weights (pounds) by state. They were not added or averaged here; each point represents a number for a state in a given year.](process_ad_commercial_files/figure-pdf/fig-WaveComparison-1.pdf){#fig-WaveComparison}
:::
:::

-   `landings_annual`
-   `landings_seas`
-   `tripTick_abund`
